justification: The only correspondence is that each surface centres on a single limbed creature, which is about as generic as depicted content gets; A shows a naturalistically modelled quadruped collapsed in profile beneath the legs of other figures, with musculature, mane and articulated joints, while B shows an isolated, crudely pecked schematic figure with radiating stick-like limbs and no companions or scene. Nothing about posture, attributes, combination or drawing convention is shared.
